about: Westward Waves Surf School teaches on the beach at Westward Ho! in north Devon. Lessons start from its converted horsebox at Northam Burrows Country Park. It takes complete beginners and intermediate surfers, in group or one-to-one lessons.
offers: Group lessons for mixed abilities and ages
where: Converted horsebox on the beach, Northam Burrows Country Park, Westward Ho!
goodToKnow: Group lessons include all kit and a 20-minute beach talk
gaps: No ages, accreditation, season, what-to-bring or cancellation terms; hire page not checked.
